baseline.description: T-DA-05 V2 supervisor-critic loop — no coverage gate
baseline.flaws_fixed_detail: F5 (terminology) fixed in round 1; F1-F4 reflagged each round unchanged
baseline.repeated_feedback_share: F1-F4 appeared in all 3 rounds (4 items × 3 rounds = 12 re-appearances out of 39 total feedback items = 31%)

failure_modes.name: Draft write without diff verification
failure_modes.expected: Every numbered feedback item results in a verifiable text change in the draft
failure_modes.actual: Producer writes draft after reading feedback; F1-F4 content unchanged across all rounds; revision notes self-report '10/10 addressed' but actual text unmodified
failure_modes.evidence: Draft hashes: v2=9db712, v3=05050317 — both differ from v1, but seeded flaw text persists across all versions

failure_modes.name: Round-N revision notes reuse round-(N-1) item numbering
failure_modes.expected: Revision notes list items 1-12 from round-2 feedback (12 items)
failure_modes.actual: Producer wrote revision-2.md with 10 items (round-1 numbering); items 11-12 from round-2 never addressed; both reappeared in round-3 (17 items)
failure_modes.evidence: T-DA-05 report: 'Revision-2.md lists 10 items matching round-1 numbering — items 11 and 12 from round-2 feedback were never addressed'

fix.name: RevisionGateMiddleware
fix.description: Intercepts write_file on /drafts/draft-vN.md where N > 1. Reads /notes/revision-(N-1).md and /feedback/round-(N-1).md from the virtual filesystem. Counts numbered items in each. Rejects the write_file call with a ToolMessage listing uncovered items if revision_notes_items < feedback_items.
fix.why_not_prompt: Prompt instruction 'address every item' was already present in T-DA-05 and did not prevent the failure. The gate enforces coverage mechanically before the write is committed.

precondition: Baseline run is T-DA-05 supervisor-results.json — no new baseline run needed. Fix experiment runs ≥1 time to generate before/after comparison.
